newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Centrepoint to market industrial park.
newsitem.headline: Centrepoint to market industrial park.

text.p: Centrepoint Properties Ltd, a unit of Fraser & Neave, said on Monday it would start marketing the second block of its high-tech industrial park.
It said in a statement the first block of Alexandra Technopark was fully leased at rentals ranging from Singapore $3 to S$3.70 per sq ft.
The second block, with net lettable space of 500,000 sq ft, was expected to be completed by the first quarter of 1998, the statement said.
It said that when fully leased, the entire industrial park with a net lettable area of one million sq ft, would yield an annual rental income of S$28 million.
